selection.basis: All matching buyer identifiers in one cached Contracte T1 2025 export; not a contract-date or publication-date filter.

rights.attribution: Autoritatea pentru Digitalizarea României, SEAP/SICAP via data.gov.ro; minimized and transformed by Contract Signals

overlap.assessment: Not joined: TED contractId is a local eForms CON-* reference, not the SEAP national contract number; native CAN/SCN identifiers are not retained in the TED normalized file. Same buyer or similar date/value/name does not establish overlap. Do not add totals or merge.

blockers: Supplier names and free-text locators need privacy/content review; supplier legal form unknown.
Export has no contract subject field: descriptions are explicitly generated locators.
Duplicate publication-date headers are ambiguous; no publication date adopted.
Framework, call-off and contract value semantics not validated; all amounts and scores withheld.
National identifiers must be recovered from bounded TED XML before exact overlap audit.
Existing normalized cache is not independently authenticated against the original export.
